_note: Backtest of the JKP claims series against the model's AI-attributable layoffs. Reported values from the Core file id-shock-data rows ind-ev-0069 to ind-ev-0073 (run3); model values from Model_Extreme/Medium/Slow via app/model.js, verified against the sheet's Summary on 2026-11-28. No figure here is an estimate unless marked approx.

run_rate.reading: The two mid-2026 annualisations differ from each other by 8.8% of last year's total. That is the noise floor of this instrument.

extreme.note: 602 layoffs spread across up to five years

verdict.model: not falsified — the reported path is flat within noise, which is what Slow and Medium predict
verdict.instrument: falsified — the national JKP claims series cannot see the modelled shock; it would take 1,090 AI-attributable layoffs in a single year, 1.8x the model's entire five-year Extreme total, to move the annual number by 1%
verdict.implication: S8 is the strongest instrument in the register and still blind here. Detection needs bank-level claims or a within-bank separation series, not the national total.
